A large piece of cotton fabric spread across a wooden worktop, pulled taut, lifted and gently laid down again. Separate deliberate motions, close dry microphone, no voice, no music, no continuous noise.

Heavy dressmaking scissors making four slow crisp cuts through cotton fabric on a wooden table, then the scissors set down. Separate actions with quiet between them. Close dry microphone, no voices, no music.
A small wooden drawer slides open and bumps softly against a knee, then slides closed. Three separated attempts, close dry microphone, soft restrained impacts, no cartoon noises, no voices, no music.

A small metal tape measure is pulled out across a wooden table, clicked to stop, and slowly retracted; then placed onto the table. Close dry microphone, ordinary small object, pauses, no voices or music.

A shallow tray tipped into a tiny stainless steel sink, a little water spills onto soft cloth, faucet trickles briefly and stops. Close dry microphone, restrained small quantities, no voices or music.
Six ordinary measured footsteps in soft-soled shoes on a wood floor, then a wooden chair pulled out and someone sitting. Separate actions, close dry microphone, no voices, no music, no echo.

A small cardboard packing box is opened, its flaps folded back, a small object set inside and the flaps closed. Separate deliberate actions with quiet between, close dry microphone, no voices, no music.

A small domestic cooker extractor fan switch clicks on; quiet uneven fan airflow runs for six seconds, then clicks to a lower speed and stays there. Microphone beside the kitchen worktop, no voices or music, no frying noise.
